title: Delete Part shows only on an existing part, to a user with Delete
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 2 users (Admin, [User-B]) · 2 browsers · about 20 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: an Admin, who has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • [Loc-1] = the location you work in (pick it in the location switcher in the top bar).
  • [User-B]: a custom role with 'Part Library & Inventory → View' and 'Create & Edit' on, 'Delete' OFF, See Financial Data on.
  • Data at [Loc-1]: one part [Part-A].

Setup

  1. Write down: [Part-A] = ZZAUTOTEST-PL-DELVIS-01 (example).
  2. Sign in as the Admin and pick [Loc-1] in the location switcher in the top bar.
  3. At [Loc-1]: Parts → Inventory → New Inventory Part → Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL Del Visible → Part Number: [Part-A] → Category: any (e.g. Uncategorized) → Cost: 10.00 → Sell Price: 20.00 → keep the default bin row (Quantity e.g. 3) → Save.
  4. Settings → Roles & Permissions → Create custom role → name it ZZAUTOTEST PL NODEL ROLE → turn on the Parts department and 'Part Library & Inventory' View and Create & Edit (Delete OFF) → See Financial Data ON → Save.
  5. Settings → Staff → add a staff member (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL User B, with an e-mail you can open) → Role: ZZAUTOTEST PL NODEL ROLE → give access to [Loc-1] → Save → accept the invitation e-mail and set a password. [User-B] = that staff member.
  6. Open a second browser (or a private window) and sign in there as [User-B], at [Loc-1].
  7. Check the setup worked: as [User-B], search [Part-A] shows the row.
custom_steps:
1. As the Admin: click New Inventory Part.
  2. Click Cancel.
  3. As the Admin: click the [Part-A] row.
  4. Click Cancel.
  5. As [User-B]: click the [Part-A] row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the New Inventory Part footer shows only Cancel and Save; no Delete Part.
  • Step 3: the Edit Inventory Part footer shows Delete Part at the left.
  • Step 5: [User-B] sees no Delete Part button.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S13-R10, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.1 (New Inventory Part opens), board 2.1 (The part as it stands). Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).
